decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - It is considered that the erection of a single storey side and rear extension to dwellinghouse is in keeping with the appearance of the dwellinghouse, will not have any adverse impacts on the amenity of the adjoining dwellings and is consistent with the character of the street scene. The proposal is consistent with the design requirements of Policies ENV B.1.1 (New Development) and H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) of the Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan 2003 and the provisions of Sections 1 and 3 of the Residential Extension Guidelines.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building(s) is/are occupied/used).
Condition : 5 - The windows formed in the ground floor elevation shall be obscure glazed, hinged to open inwards and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing.
description: Erection of a single storey side and rear extension to existing dwellinghouse.
